title: Hackathons and competitions
intro: Platforms that list hackathons, coding contests and startup competitions. Many are online and open to students in Nepal.

items.name: Devpost
items.desc: Online and in-person hackathons worldwide, with filters for open, online events.

items.name: Major League Hacking
items.desc: The official student hackathon league, plus Global Hack Weeks you can join online.

items.name: Devfolio
items.desc: Hackathons and buildathons, many hosted across South Asia.

items.name: Unstop
items.desc: Student competitions, quizzes and hackathons; check each one's eligibility for Nepal.

items.name: Kaggle Competitions
items.desc: Data science and machine learning competitions, including beginner tracks.

items.name: Codeforces
items.desc: Regular competitive programming rounds with global rankings.

items.name: ICPC
items.desc: The International Collegiate Programming Contest for university teams.

items.name: NASA Space Apps Challenge
items.desc: Yearly global hackathon using NASA's open data.

items.name: IEEEXtreme
items.desc: 24-hour global programming contest for IEEE student teams.

items.name: Advent of Code
items.desc: December programming puzzles you can solve in any language.

title: Cybersecurity and CTFs
intro: Capture-the-flag competitions and legal practice labs for building security skills.

items.name: CTFtime
items.desc: The calendar of upcoming CTF competitions, with team rankings.

items.name: picoCTF
items.desc: Beginner-friendly CTF by Carnegie Mellon University, with a year-round practice gym.

items.name: TryHackMe
items.desc: Guided, browser-based security labs and learning paths.

items.name: Hack The Box
items.desc: Hands-on hacking labs, academy courses and competitions.

items.name: OverTheWire
items.desc: Free wargames; Bandit is a classic start for Linux skills.

items.name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
items.desc: Free web security training with interactive labs.

items.name: SANS Holiday Hack Challenge
items.desc: Free, story-driven security game each winter, with past editions online.

items.name: BSides Kathmandu
items.desc: Nepal's first BSides security conference, with a live CTF.

title: Open-source programmes
intro: Paid and unpaid programmes where you contribute to real open-source projects with mentors.

items.name: Google Summer of Code
items.desc: Paid, mentored open-source work for new contributors.

items.name: Outreachy
items.desc: Paid remote internships in open source and open science.

items.name: LFX Mentorship
items.desc: Paid mentorships on Linux Foundation projects, three terms a year.

items.name: MLH Fellowship
items.desc: 12-week remote fellowship with an educational stipend.

items.name: Hacktoberfest
items.desc: October's open-source celebration, with online and local events.

items.name: Good First Issue
items.desc: Beginner-friendly issues from popular open-source projects.

title: Internships, fellowships and jobs
intro: Job portals in Nepal and remote boards. Always apply through the company's own page when you can.

items.name: MeroJob
items.desc: One of Nepal's largest job portals, including IT roles and internships.

items.name: KumariJob
items.desc: Nepali job portal with IT, banking and NGO listings.

items.name: JobsNepal
items.desc: Long-running Nepali job board.

items.name: LinkedIn Jobs
items.desc: Search "intern" with location Nepal or Remote, and set job alerts.

items.name: Wellfound
items.desc: Startup jobs, many remote-friendly.

items.name: Fusemachines AI Fellowship
items.desc: Six-month AI programme in Nepal with full scholarships for selected candidates.

items.name: Teach For Nepal
items.desc: Two-year paid fellowship teaching in public schools.

title: Scholarships and study abroad
intro: Official scholarship sites only. Government scholarships never ask you to pay an agent to apply.

items.name: Chevening (UK)
items.desc: Fully funded UK master's scholarships.

items.name: Fulbright Commission in Nepal
items.desc: Fulbright programmes for Nepali students and scholars.

items.name: MEXT via Embassy of Japan in Nepal
items.desc: Japanese government scholarships for Nepali students.

items.name: DAAD Scholarship Database
items.desc: Search scholarships for study and research in Germany.

items.name: Erasmus Mundus Catalogue
items.desc: EU-funded joint master's programmes across Europe.

items.name: Embassy of Korea in Nepal notices
items.desc: Official GKS scholarship notices and deadlines for Nepali applicants.

items.name: Study in Korea (GKS)
items.desc: Korean government's portal for international students and GKS scholarships.

title: Communities and events in Nepal
intro: Tech communities and event calendars close to home.

items.name: dev.events: Nepal
items.desc: Calendar of developer conferences and meetups in Nepal.

items.name: GDG Kathmandu
items.desc: Google Developer Group in Kathmandu, organisers of DevFest Kathmandu.

items.name: PgConf.Nepal
items.desc: Nepal's PostgreSQL conference, Kathmandu, November 2026.

items.name: AI Conf (Web Weekend Kathmandu)
items.desc: AI conference in Kathmandu, 8 to 10 Jan 2027.

items.name: Code for Nepal
items.desc: Nonprofit working on open data and digital literacy in Nepal.

items.name: WordCamp Nepal 2027
items.desc: National WordPress conference, Nepalgunj, 29 to 30 Jan 2027.

items.name: BSides Kathmandu 2026
items.desc: Security conference in Kathmandu on 21 Nov 2026.

title: Volunteering
intro: Use your skills for causes and communities, online or close to home.

items.name: UN Online Volunteering
items.desc: Remote assignments with UN agencies and partners, for anyone 18 or older.

items.name: HOT Tasking Manager
items.desc: Map buildings and roads for humanitarian projects on OpenStreetMap.

items.name: Zooniverse
items.desc: Citizen science projects anyone can help with online.

items.name: Teach For Nepal
items.desc: Fellowship and volunteer pathways in Nepal's public schools.

title: Free tools for students
intro: Professional tools you can use free while you study.

items.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
items.desc: GitHub Pro, cloud credits and dozens of partner tools.

items.name: JetBrains for students
items.desc: Free licences for JetBrains IDEs while you study.

items.name: Azure for Students
items.desc: Cloud credit for students, no credit card required.

items.name: Figma for Education
items.desc: Free Figma plans for students and educators.
